description: Ex-JASDF two-seat F-104DJ; displayed for years beside the Shuiyun Bridge in Shuili Township Nantou; in January 2017 the township office asked the Air Force to take it back to make way for a cycle-path scheme and the university offered to take it on; the ROCAF then placed it at the Yunlin campus
museum_name: Chung Hua University of Medical Technology Yunlin Campus F-104
